title: Ralph Cooper's band at the M and S Theater
summary: Marge recalls the M and S Theater band in new blue uniforms, led by the dancer Ralph Cooper who could not hold a saxophone, with Henry Goodwin and Gus McLeod on trumpets; it rivalled the Apollo and was soon renamed the Harlem.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: But in the last band I was always with Zutty. That's why I know what happened got to go with him every place and they made Ralph Cooper the leader of the band and I don't know what big gig you all were going on because you had these beautiful new uniforms and it was night you were rehearsing.

And Ralph Cooper was supposed to play the saxophone. He didn't know how to hold a saxophone. They were teaching him that night and I saw it, I was there. They had to teach him how to hold the saxophone.
